recognize_zh: 這是未染色腦脊髓液在血球計數盤格線上的濕片，中央的「細胞」是一顆邊界清楚、內含細小顆粒與小折光點的圓形顆粒，沒有真正的核構造，實為鞘內注射的脂質體阿糖胞苷（DepoCyte）顆粒，造成假性白血球增多。
features: Unstained wet preparation in a hemocytometer counting chamber with visible grid lines
Large round particle with a crisp refractile outer membrane and fine internal granular/vesicular texture
Tiny refractile dots within the particle but no discernible nucleus
Few smaller round refractile bodies in the background
No red cells or clearly nucleated leukocytes identified
describe_en: Unstained cerebrospinal fluid examined in a hemocytometer chamber shows a large round particle with a sharp refractile outline and a finely granular internal texture containing tiny refractile dots, without a definable nucleus. A few smaller round refractile bodies are present in the background. Nucleated cell identification cannot be made reliably on an unstained chamber count. In a patient receiving intrathecal liposomal cytarabine, these structures are consistent with DepoCyte lipid particles, which can be miscounted as white cells (spurious pleocytosis); a stained cytospin should be reviewed before attributing an elevated count to disease progression.

ddx.vs: Malignant lymphoid cells are nucleated and persist on stained cytospin, whereas DepoCyte particles are anuclear and do not survive cytospin preparation.
Cryptococci are smaller budding yeasts with a clear capsule highlighted by India ink, not large finely vesicular spheres.

ddx.dx: Starch granules or glove powder contaminant
ddx.vs: Starch granules show a central Maltese-cross birefringence under polarized light.
Macrophages have a visible eccentric nucleus and vacuolated cytoplasm on stained preparations.
